meta.name: Sinner The Secret Diary Of A Nymphomaniac
meta.description: Linda comes to the big city in search of fun and excitement.  What she finds is exploitation and abuse at the hands of a succession of sleazy guys.  Searching for love, she enters into a lesbian relationship with a beautiful countess, discovers drugs and swingers' parties and starts acting in porno movies.  She also begins to write a secret diary...
meta.slogan: Linda Loves her work, and her work is LOVE...
